name: menu-macos
description: The entries of the native macOS menu bar run their commands. The menu bar itself is an OS menu, so the journey drives the same commands the menu items run.

steps.why: the browser starts with one tab
the New Tab entry of the native menu is run
the app has a moment to open the tab
the New Tab entry opened a second tab
the Settings entry of the native menu is run
the app has a moment to open the settings
the Settings entry opened the settings tab
